name: production-dashboard-ui-ux
description: Production dashboard UI/UX design, audit, runtime design governance, personalization, accessibility, performance, responsive behavior, and RTL/LTR workflows.

interface.longDescription: Design, audit, improve, and redesign production dashboards and operational product interfaces. Includes existing-product UX review, reusable design-system architecture, safe owner-controlled runtime appearance settings, user personalization and saved views, Data Trust UX, responsive behavior, Persian RTL and English LTR, Light/Dark themes, branding, accessibility, performance, tables, forms, navigation, and regression-aware visual QA.
capabilities: Improve personalization and Data Trust UX
defaultPrompt: Audit this dashboard, fix safe UI/UX issues, preserve behavior, and report remaining risks.
Design a safe owner UI/UX control center with preview, validation, publish, rollback, and audit history.
Improve this dashboard's personalization, saved views, data trust, RTL/LTR, accessibility, and responsiveness.
